task_instance: Planning-only request: produce a version-aware NVIDIA Parabricks `pbrun fq2bam` command (Parabricks 4.8.0) for a WGS germline sample with two paired-end FASTQ lanes and two known-sites VCFs, emitting a coordinate-sorted, duplicate-marked BAM plus a BQSR report, with Docker envelope, placeholders, and validation checks.
evidence: The skill's core deliverable is to plan pbrun commands and give version-aware command guidance; the skill states that command guidance needs no NGC credential, GPU, or container runtime (planning-only). Read SKILL.md and bundled references references/pbrun-fq2bam.md, references/command-conventions.md, references/shared-options.md. Created input manifest at <work>/sample_manifest.json (user-supplied sample metadata). Produced the deliverable at <work>/fq2bam_command.md: a correct `pbrun fq2bam` command inside a Docker envelope with --ref, two repeated --in-fq pairs for the two lanes, two repeated --knownSites, --out-bam and --out-recal-file. Verified against references: (1) fq2bam is the right tool for short-read paired-end DNA; (2) repeated --in-fq for multiple same-sample pairs per pbrun-fq2bam.md; (3) --knownSites + --out-recal-file BQSR pairing per the shared-options 'Duplicate marking and recalibration' rows; (4) image tag 4.8.0-1 for release 4.8.0 per SKILL.md instruction 1; (5) required-argument completeness (--ref, --in-fq, --out-bam) per command-conventions.md validation; (6) placeholders kept visible for the redacted registry host, the manifest digest, and the un-provided read-group strings, honoring the guardrail against inventing read groups; (7) container paths rewritten consistently under the /workdir and /outputdir mounts. No code execution, binary output, network, credentials, or MCP/shell tools were needed; the task was completed with text read/write only. The bundled scripts (check_parabricks_runtime.sh, translate_star_to_parabricks.py) were not needed for this planning-only instance and were not run.
